activity.notes: Tembinok' is the form used by Robert Louis Stevenson for Tem Binoka/Binoka. He succeeded his father in 1878 and ruled the centralized State of Abemama, including Abemama, Kuria and Aranuka, until his death on 10 November 1891.

sources.title: Series N, Section 2: The would-be Empire Builder — University of Adelaide
sources.citation_text: The University of Adelaide archival description states that King Tem Binoka of Apemama took over from his father in 1878 and ruled until 1891.

sources.title: In the South Seas — Robert Louis Stevenson
sources.citation_text: Stevenson's first-hand account describes Tembinok' as the monarch of Apemama and explains how his father and uncle established the centralized monarchy he inherited.
